universities.campusLifestyle: The Tiruchirappalli campus brings together academic departments, laboratories, hostels, sports and student activities. Technical and cultural events, departmental associations and student clubs form part of campus life. The Dean of Students Welfare coordinates student activities, mentoring and welfare services; particular facilities and participation arrangements should be checked when joining.
universities.cityProfile: The campus is on Tanjore Road at Thuvakudi, Tiruchirappalli 620015, near BHEL. The institution describes its location as about 17 km from Tiruchirappalli Railway Junction. Confirm the actual admission venue and hostel arrangements before planning arrival: new-cohort reporting can take place at Barn Hall or the named department rather than a classroom building. Travel, accommodation and everyday expenses are separate from tuition.
universities.practicalExposure: Engineering postgraduate study includes programme core and elective courses, laboratory requirements and project work. Architecture and planning have studio and project components. The science and computing programmes follow their discipline-specific practical or project requirements; MCA retains six semesters. The MBA combines management coursework with practical exposure such as industrial visits, seminars and workshops. Integrated B.Sc.B.Ed. combines a science major with teacher education and secondary-school teaching preparation. Externally hosted projects or sponsored arrangements require the programme’s approval and should not be assumed for every student.
universities.hostelOverview: The institution operates hostels and messes, with separate 2026–27 notices for newly admitted undergraduate and postgraduate/research students. Hostel allocation and fee payment require their own admission process; tuition is not a bundled accommodation price. Check room availability, the current hostel rules and mess advance before travel, particularly for late reporting or any approved external project period.
universities.dietarySupport: Institute messes are administered separately from academic tuition. Confirm the available mess, current menu, meal charges and any vegetarian or other dietary requirement before choosing accommodation. An individual dietary or certification requirement needs confirmation from the specific mess rather than an assumption based on the campus location.
universities.safetyOverview: Campus security operates in shifts and checks vehicles at the entry points. The institutional hospital publishes casualty, outpatient/inpatient facilities, an ambulance and pharmacy services. Obtain current emergency contacts and medical/insurance requirements when joining; individual treatment needs require confirmation.
universities.studentSupport: The Dean of Students Welfare coordinates student activities, mentoring, scholarships and insurance-related administration. The Counselling and Guidance Cell supports student wellbeing and grievance channels are identified by the welfare office. Academic, admission and hostel sections have separate document and fee processes.

faq.question: Which entrance route applies to my programme?
faq.answer: B.Tech/B.Arch use the appropriate JEE Main paper and JoSAA/CSAB allocation, with distinct DASA/ICCR/SII routes for eligible categories. B.Sc.B.Ed. uses NCET and separate major preferences. M.Tech/M.Arch/M.Plan use programme-specific CCMT/GATE requirements; MSc uses CCMN/JAM, MCA uses NIMCET, MA uses CUET(PG)English and regular MBA uses CAT.

faq.question: Is MCA two years or three years?
faq.answer: NIT Tiruchirappalli’s current directory and 2024 postgraduate regulations specify six semesters for MCA. This offering is therefore three years. A two-year MCA at another institution does not change this programme’s verified duration.

faq.question: How are MTech qualifying degrees and GATE papers checked?
faq.answer: The exact degree branch and GATE paper must appear together in the 2026 programme mapping. Some specialties accept several ordered groups; others are narrow. Data Analytics lists BE/BTech disciplines, M.Sc. disciplines and MCA with the specified papers, while Thermal Power Engineering has a Mechanical Engineering/ME combination. A generic relevant-degree statement is insufficient.

faq.question: What is the MSc Computer Science entrance paper?
faq.answer: The verified 2026 CCMN mapping for MSc Computer Science uses JAM Mathematical Statistics(MS). It also requires the listed bachelor award and at least four semesters/two years of the specified Mathematics/Statistics/computing-related subjects. Do not substitute a differently named entrance test.

faq.question: Are the B.Sc. B.Ed. science majors separate admissions?
faq.answer: The current brochure requires a separate application and preference for Physics, Chemistry or Mathematics, with a major-level seat matrix. Each four-year bachelor route combines that science major with teacher education for the Secondary Stage. Its three-year BSc exit is a progression option, not a separate direct admission.

faq.question: What tuition is confirmed for Indian admission categories?
faq.answer: The 2026 batch fee tables list semester tuition of INR 62,500 for BTech/BArch, INR 50,000 for B.Sc. B.Ed., INR 35,000 for MTech/MArch/MCA/MBA andINR 7,500 for MSc/MA before applicable waivers. Annual baselines multiply two fee semesters. Institute annual fees, one-time charges, deposits, hostel and mess remain separate. MPlan regular tuition follows the explicit MTech/MArch payment-category instruction and linked tariff.

faq.question: Do all PwD students receive the same tuition waiver?
faq.answer: No. The UG BTech/BArch table waives tuition for SC/ST and all PwD categories. The postgraduate OPEN-PwD/OBC-PwD table still lists tuition; the separate SC/ST table waives it. B.Sc. B.Ed.’s published waiver scope is SC/ST. Use the exact programme’s fee-category notice rather than extending one table to every award.

faq.question: How are overseas DASA requirements different?
faq.answer: UG DASA uses the prescribed JEE Main paper, school subjects, marks, age and overseas-residence rules. PG DASA uses its accepted qualification/residence categories and GRE(minimum 280 Verbal + Quantitative), or GMAT(minimum 480)for MBA; NIT’s own special restriction is 60%orCGPA 6.5/10. Branch equivalence and fee category need separate verification.

faq.question: Are overseas tuition amounts in rupees or dollars?
faq.answer: Published DASA categories use USD 2,000 per semester for eligible SAARC students and USD 4,000 for non-SAARC/NRI categories. Institute-specific rupee charges and hostel costs are additional. ICCR or CIWG treatment depends on the exact awarded category; it is not implied by nationality alone.

faq.question: Which intake dates are actually verified?
faq.answer: The 2026 UG and B.Sc. B.Ed. admission cohorts reported in August; MBA reporting was 6 July 2026. The MTech/MSc/MCA/MA new-cohort notice states classwork from 13 August 2026. These dated notices do not promise the next year’s deadlines or class starts.

faq.question: Does accreditation cover every programme?
faq.answer: Institute of National Importance is statutory institutional status. NBA accreditation is programme-specific: the own list verifies Chemical, ECE, EEE and Metallurgical/Materials UG through 30 June 2028, and Mechanical/Instrumentation and Control through 30 June 2029. Expired Civil, Production and CSE entries are not represented as current. NCTE recognition separately concerns ITEP B.Sc. B.Ed.Secondary Stage.

faq.question: Is accommodation included with tuition?
faq.answer: Hostel and mess payments have separate institutional notices and admission steps. Confirm allocation, room availability, meal arrangements and current charges before travel. External projects, sponsored routes and research categories may have different residence requirements. The hospital and student-welfare offices provide separate support services.

items: For JoSAA/CSAB 2026: first Class XII/equivalent appearance in 2024, 2025 or 2026, with at least five subjects; meet 75% aggregate (65% SC/ST/PwD) or the category-wise top-20-percentile criterion.
For B.Tech, pass Physics, Mathematics, a language, one of Chemistry/Biology/Biotechnology/Technical Vocational subject and one other subject; the prescribed five-subject aggregation applies.
Obtain the required JEE Main 2026 Paper 1 rank and programme allocation through JoSAA/CSAB; the exact nationality, category and seat-allocation rules apply.
DASA 2026 uses JEE Main Paper 1, birth on/after 1 October 2001 and 75%/7.5 aggregate in five subjects, with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry/Biotechnology/Computer Science/Biology.
DASA foreign/OCI/PIO/NRI categories and residence evidence are separate: Indian nationals need the stipulated two years of foreign education including Classes XI–XII and must pass them abroad.

JoSAA NIT+ seats exclude foreign nationals and OCI/PIO(F). Pre-4-March-2021 OCI/PIO holders choosing Indian parity may use OPEN/OPEN-PwD seats; later cards require the separate eligible overseas route.

applicationSteps: Choose the exact programme and admission category in its institutional or central counselling application.
Submit qualifying records and the specified entrance result, complete selection or allocation and accept the written offer.
Complete original-document verification and confirm tuition category, joining instructions and accommodation before reporting.

academic: Qualifying school/degree certificate and complete marksheets, with the required subjects
Specified entrance examination result or scorecard and any required qualification-equivalence evidence
application: Identity and nationality documents and the programme offer/allotment letter
Applicable category, disability, income and migration/transfer documents
Passport, visa and the required overseas-route records where applicable

admissionsContent.deadlinesNote: The verified 2026 new undergraduate cohort had physical admission reporting on 18–20 August 2026. This confirms the August 2026 cohort, not a future or exact class-start date; follow the next joining notice.

programmes.mediumNote: The current Academic Office certificate expressly identifies English instruction and assessment for all academic programmes, including this named award type.
programmes.feeNotes: For the 2026 admission batch, published tuition is INR 62,500 per fee semester; the annual tuition baseline INR 125,000 is two-semester arithmetic. Institute annual charges, one-time fees, deposits, hostel and mess are separate. SC/ST and all PwD tuition is waived. Eligible OPEN/EWS/OBC-NCL family income below INR 1 lakh receives full remission; INR 1–5 lakh receives two-thirds remission, subject to the prescribed income certificate.

teachingPhases.details: Disciplinary coursework and the degree’s laboratory, studio, practical, project or internship requirements; confirm the exact curriculum and approved training locations.

additionalFees.notes: Eligible DASA SAARC category: tuition USD 2,000 per semester; annual baseline is two-semester arithmetic. Confirm the awarded admission category; institute/hostel charges and deposits are separate. The published UG table covers DASA/SII.

DASA non-SAARC/NRI category: tuition USD 4,000 per semester; annual baseline is two-semester arithmetic. Confirm the awarded admission category; institute/hostel charges and deposits are separate. The published UG table covers DASA/SII.

fee.notes: For the 2026 admission batch, published tuition is INR 62,500 per fee semester; the annual tuition baseline INR 125,000 is two-semester arithmetic. Institute annual charges, one-time fees, deposits, hostel and mess are separate. SC/ST and all PwD tuition is waived. Eligible OPEN/EWS/OBC-NCL family income below INR 1 lakh receives full remission; INR 1–5 lakh receives two-thirds remission, subject to the prescribed income certificate.

eligibleAudiences: Applicants meeting the exact academic, examination and admission-category requirements below
restrictions: JoSAA/CSAB and DASA are separate seat-allocation routes. DASA overseas-school equivalence, nationality and residence evidence must be checked together.
For DASA CIWG, the qualifying NRI parent’s Gulf employment and prescribed documents are required; the fee category is not automatic.
audienceEligibility.notes: Apply through the route matching the qualification, nationality and intended cohort. Other routes require their own admission and fee-category verification.

For B.Tech, pass Physics, Mathematics, a language, one of Chemistry/Biology/Biotechnology/Technical Vocational subject and one other subject; the prescribed five-subject aggregation applies. Obtain the required JEE Main 2026 Paper 1 rank and programme allocation through JoSAA/CSAB; the exact nationality, category and seat-allocation rules apply. DASA foreign/OCI/PIO/NRI categories and residence evidence are separate: Indian nationals need the stipulated two years of foreign education including Classes XI–XII and must pass them abroad. JoSAA NIT+ seats exclude foreign nationals and OCI/PIO(F). Pre-4-March-2021 OCI/PIO holders choosing Indian parity may use OPEN/OPEN-PwD seats; later cards require the separate eligible overseas route.

evidence.claimText: National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli is a public technical institution in Tamil Nadu offering engineering, architecture, planning, science, teacher education, management and research programmes. Residential study combines disciplinary coursework with laboratory, studio and project requirements, while admission routes vary by award and applicant category.
evidence.sourceLabel: Official institutional facilities or academic scope

evidence.claimText: The Tiruchirappalli campus brings together academic departments, laboratories, hostels, sports and student activities. Technical and cultural events, departmental associations and student clubs form part of campus life. The Dean of Students Welfare coordinates student activities, mentoring and welfare services; particular facilities and participation arrangements should be checked when joining.
evidence.sourceLabel: Official institutional facilities or academic scope

evidence.claimText: The campus is on Tanjore Road at Thuvakudi, Tiruchirappalli 620015, near BHEL. The institution describes its location as about 17 km from Tiruchirappalli Railway Junction. Confirm the actual admission venue and hostel arrangements before planning arrival: new-cohort reporting can take place at Barn Hall or the named department rather than a classroom building. Travel, accommodation and everyday expenses are separate from tuition.
evidence.sourceLabel: Official institutional facilities or academic scope

evidence.claimText: Engineering postgraduate study includes programme core and elective courses, laboratory requirements and project work. Architecture and planning have studio and project components. The science and computing programmes follow their discipline-specific practical or project requirements; MCA retains six semesters. The MBA combines management coursework with practical exposure such as industrial visits, seminars and workshops. Integrated B.Sc.B.Ed. combines a science major with teacher education and secondary-school teaching preparation. Externally hosted projects or sponsored arrangements require the programme’s approval and should not be assumed for every student.
evidence.sourceLabel: Official institutional facilities or academic scope

evidence.claimText: The institution operates hostels and messes, with separate 2026–27 notices for newly admitted undergraduate and postgraduate/research students. Hostel allocation and fee payment require their own admission process; tuition is not a bundled accommodation price. Check room availability, the current hostel rules and mess advance before travel, particularly for late reporting or any approved external project period.
evidence.sourceLabel: Official institutional facilities or academic scope

evidence.claimText: Institute messes are administered separately from academic tuition. Confirm the available mess, current menu, meal charges and any vegetarian or other dietary requirement before choosing accommodation. An individual dietary or certification requirement needs confirmation from the specific mess rather than an assumption based on the campus location.
evidence.sourceLabel: Official institutional facilities or academic scope

evidence.claimText: Campus security operates in shifts and checks vehicles at the entry points. The institutional hospital publishes casualty, outpatient/inpatient facilities, an ambulance and pharmacy services. Obtain current emergency contacts and medical/insurance requirements when joining; individual treatment needs require confirmation.
evidence.sourceLabel: Official institutional facilities or academic scope

evidence.claimText: The Dean of Students Welfare coordinates student activities, mentoring, scholarships and insurance-related administration. The Counselling and Guidance Cell supports student wellbeing and grievance channels are identified by the welfare office. Academic, admission and hostel sections have separate document and fee processes.
evidence.sourceLabel: Official institutional facilities or academic scope
